description: Each client's marketplace index (ADR-0001): Copilot's lists every plugin under ./copilot/; Claude Code's (.claude-plugin) and Codex's (.agents/plugins) list the plugins their adapters build, under ./claude/ and ./codex/. A plugin with a Copilot agent builds only for Copilot; one whose server sets cwd does not build for Claude Code; build.json records both under notBuilt. Codex entries carry the fixed policy and the plugin's category, or Productivity.
